{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 自动审批插件：关键词 + 审核模型审核表。","id":"gh:1366140902","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-auto-approve","slug":"DNAlec/dsh-auto-approve","topics":["approval","auto-approve","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 自动审批插件：关键词 + 审核模型审核表。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-auto-approve"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-approves or rejects tool calls with **keywords** and a **judge m"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"odel that returns a category plus a risk level**. Every category has three cells (low / medium / hig"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"h), all yours to configure. Uncertainty goes to the original Web approval dialog."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Or from npm, after a tagged release:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> To pin a reproducible version, append `#vX.Y.Z` (the tag must match `package.json`, which the publ"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ish workflow checks)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Restart `dsh web`. The first start adds the **Auto-approve** permission preset to the current profil"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e's `cordis.patch.yml`; if that write fails, the log line names the file and the reason."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Setup"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Settings → **Auto-approve**. Each control on the page carries one line of hint; the rules live here:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. **Auto-approve mode** — in-workspace writes skip approval (`workspace-write`, recommended), or se"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nd them through the judge (`read-only`). Clicking a mode writes it; restart `dsh web`, then re-selec"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"t **Auto-approve** or start a new session.
2. **Keywords** — three buckets: reject / human / allow. "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"They match the **tool name, command, path, and working directory**, plus the values of custom-tool ("},{"id":"p13s5","text":"MCP and friends) arguments with unrecognized names; they **never see written contents, code bodies, "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"or numeric/boolean switches** (`{content:"rm -rf /"}`, `{recursive:true}` are judged by the model on"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ly). Reject/human words also match the tool name; allow words match neither the tool name nor the se"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ssion directory, so `bash`/`write` is never allowed as a class.
3. **Criteria table** — a row is an "},{"id":"p13s9","text":"English `id` + a description (state when to pick this id) + three cells (low/medium/high → action). "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"The judge sees only the id and the description; the plugin runs the action in the **(row, level)** c"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"ell. `other` cannot be deleted, but its description and cells are editable. The id is what the appro"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"val history shows.
4. **Risk levels** — all three descriptions go into the prompt. **When the level "},{"id":"p13s13","text":"is unreadable** (default `high`) also decides *which cell of that row* runs, so it decides the outco"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"me: a `high` fallback rejects such calls, `medium` asks a human, `low` allows them.
5. **Judge model"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"** — model, reasoning effort, judge timeout, the **judge request limit**, the **output budget (token"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"s)**, and whether a call that is **over the limit / hit the collection guard** goes to a human or is"},{"id":"p13s17","text":" rejected (**arguments not captured are always rejected; not configurable** — see “How it works”). T"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"he same card holds the **judge prompt**: `{{criteria}}` inserts the criteria table and `{{levels}}` "},{"id":"p13s19","text":"the level descriptions; a missing placeholder appends that block. It is editable, and restoring writ"},{"id":"p13s20","text":"es the shipped template of the language you pick and switches the language to it.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Runs only when the session preset is Auto-approve. With `workspace-write`, in-workspace writes never"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" reach approval. `danger-full-access` uses the same pipeline."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Pipeline: **reject keywords → “arguments not captured” is always rejected (no human dialog: a plugin"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"-side capture failure, and the model is told to re-issue the same call) → human keywords → the “can "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"we see it?” gate (collection guard hit / over the judge request limit: the action chosen on the **Ju"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"dge model** card, a human by default) → allow keywords → judge (category + level) → the (row, level)"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" cell**. Both halves matter: an explicit reject/human keyword also covers calls the gate catches, wh"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"ile an allow keyword can never let those through. Results outside the table split in two: a verdict "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"the model **did** produce but that cannot be classified runs the **fallback row `other`'s cells**; a"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" judgment that **never produced a result** (empty output, timeout, call failure, no usable route, pl"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ugin error) is not a verdict at all and **always goes to a human**, without consulting `other`'s cel"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"ls. A cancelled request produces no verdict. **There is no “how much content” gate**: below the limi"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"t the card goes to the judge exactly as built — empty arguments, a lone `description`/`workdir`, pur"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"e numeric/boolean switches all included; the “nothing reviewable” switch has been removed outright ("},{"id":"p16s13","text":"ic/boolean switches all included; the “nothing reviewable” switch has been removed outright ( [长行截断]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## The judge model: “Model default” does not mean “do not think”"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The Reasoning dropdown offers **Model default** (an empty value) plus whatever levels the route adve"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"rtises. **Model default does not turn thinking off**: it is implemented as **leaving the reasoning o"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ption out of the request**. Saying nothing is not the same as saying “off” — the model falls back to"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" its own default, and a model that thinks by default keeps thinking. Reasoning tokens and the answer"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" **share the same output ceiling**, so when reasoning eats the budget you get `finish=max-tokens`, n"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"o text at all → the judgment fails → **it always asks a human** (safe, but you will see “why is ever"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"ything popping a dialog?”)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The plugin handles this on its own, so you do not need to understand the above:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## After a rejection: the model learns why, and can ask you"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"On an auto-reject, DSH itself only tells the model `the user rejected tool "…"` — which is **the wro"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ng attribution**: keyword red lines, criteria verdicts, and plugin errors all look like a human "no""},{"id":"p23s3","text":". This plugin attaches a note to that denied call saying it was a **machine verdict**, why (the matc"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"hed keyword, the criteria row id and level, missing/truncated payload, the exact judge-failure sourc"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"e), and what to do next."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The reason is built only from **closed-set** facts: keywords from your own list, category ids from y"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"our own table. The judge model's prose `reason` is **never echoed back** — it carries command fragme"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"nts and file contents, so re-injecting it would open an injection path."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"A human denial, and "escalated but nobody answered", get their own wording too: DSH renders both as "},{"id":"p25s2","text":""the user rejected", and the model needs to know who actually said no."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Model-initiated human review (off by default)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Once enabled in the settings page, every auto-reject notice offers the model one more route: **if it"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" believes the step is required, it can escalate that one operation to a human decision.**"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
